lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately horizontal rows with consistent spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a structured matrix or grid of anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, showing a sharp luminance gradient with light pixels on the superior edge and shadow pixels on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-luminance curved linear feature is visible posterior to the gill region, suggesting either a significant scar or an attached commensal organism.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense population of high-contrast, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) clustered around the lower head and pectoral regions.
